title: Cassette
summary: A tape-deck sound recorder: WAV, FLAC, Opus, USB and Bluetooth headsets.
description: Records from USB sound cards and headsets, and Bluetooth headsets on boards with a sound server (PipeWire), to WAV, FLAC or Opus: level meter, gain, timer, live monitor, trim, split, merge, playback with 5x scan, also to Bluetooth speakers. Crash-safe: a take survives a power cut. No cloud: nothing leaves the board. Needs a screen of 480x320 or more.
depends: libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, libasound2t64 | libasound2, libopus0, libopusenc0, libflac14 | libflac12t64 | libflac12, libpulse0
